crossRefs.note: How long, Yahweh? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?
How long, Yahweh? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?
Will you be angry with us forever? Will you draw out your anger to all generations?
Relent, Yahweh! How long? Have compassion on your servants!
Why do you stand far off, Yahweh? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?
Yahweh, why do you reject my soul? Why do you hide your face from me?
He works to the north, but I can’t see him. He turns south, but I can’t catch a glimpse of him.
I will wait for Yahweh, who hides his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.
Most certainly you are a God who has hidden yourself, God of Israel, the Savior.’ ”

House of David, Yahweh says, ‘Execute justice in the morning, and deliver him who is robbed out of the hand of the…
punishing those who don’t know God, and to those who don’t obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus,

translations.web: How long, Yahweh? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?
translations.bsb: How long, O LORD? Will You hide Yourself forever? Will Your wrath keep burning like fire?
translations.kjv: How long, LORD? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy wrath burn like fire?
translations.asv: How long, O Jehovah? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? How long shall thy wrath burn like fire?
